text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged into the main project. Their primary benefit is catching bugs early, which saves significant time and money compared to fixing issues after release. Beyond this, reviews promote knowledge sharing, as less experienced developers learn from senior colleagues while discussing different approaches. This process also raises overall team quality, since writing code that others will read encourages more careful, cleaner programming. Ultimately, regular code reviews build a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement, making the entire team more effective and confident in their work.
